headline: Thomas Meets A Second Hull Bend
deck: Sorba Thomas, owned by test3331, in a crash near Hull's training ground, the second such incident
body:
A second Hull City player has crashed near the training ground, and for this league the name that matters is Sorba Thomas, who belongs to test3331. The first involved Lucas Gourna-Douath; this one, test3331's man.

What it costs the squad is not yet known. No injury has been flagged and no absence confirmed, so test3331 is left with the same asset and a reason to watch the next team sheet closely.
